description: Wallet snapshot on Base. Native ETH balance, nonce (tx count) and whether the address is a contract, on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or Optimism. Deterministic, no LLM. Example output: {"chain":"base","address":"0x…","ethWei":"0","eth":"0","nonce":0,"isContract":false,"block":1}. Price: $0.0025 USDC on Base via x402 (pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"]).
name: base_wallet
